_comment: The shape of `bothy module list --json` (cli/internal/install/module.go, ModuleRow). The modules, their descriptions, services, requirements and memory are the ones declared in stack/modes.yml, held by a test; which of them is installed on this example box is made up.

modules.name: edge
modules.description: The front door - Traefik with the file provider only (no Docker socket), publishing the one host port.

modules.name: files
modules.description: Read-only notes reader - one folder, no write routes (this box has no login yet).

modules.name: node-metrics
modules.description: Read-only machine numbers (memory, CPU, load, disk, network) as one text page at /-/api/node/metrics.
